name: unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T)
rule: Calling `Arc::<T>::decrement_strong_count` with a strong count of exactly 1 is permitted; the call may release the final `Arc` and its backing storage.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::sync::Arc < T > { unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T) }
